page.overview:
Who is Blue?

Jurassic World Camp Cretaceous: Hidden Adventure

Blue is a female Velociraptor who appears in , , Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous, and . She is the oldest member, and leader, of the four Velociraptors in her pack, consisting of her three younger sisters Delta, Echo, and Charlie. Blue is one of the most cunning Velociraptor of the pack. In the film, she is taught over 40 commands. In her youth, Blue fought with Echo for pack supremacy. Her bite is equivalent to that of a spotted hyena.

Trained by Owen Grady for the IBRIS Project, Blue and her pack aided in the search for the Indominus rex, only to turn against their trainer when accepting the I. rex as their Alpha. In the film, Blue show fearlessness when facing the Indominus Rex. However, Blue was the first to change her loyalty back to Owen and fight against the I. rex. While the rest of her pack was killed, Blue received aid from Rexy as well as the Mosasaurus and defeated the Indominus rex. She was subsequently encountered by the Camp Cretaceous campers, helping them to kill the two Scorpios rexes and avoid capture by Mantah Corp.

Three years later, when Isla Nublar was in danger from the eruption of Mount Sibo, Blue reunited with Owen only to be captured and shipped to Lockwood Manor to create the next generation of the Indoraptor. After Blue was healed from her injury, she once again saved Owen, Claire, and Maisie from the Indoraptor, defeating it. Following that, Blue ran off into the woods, now free.
